name: Kagura Hikari
source:
"I have no more need for fate, nor vows."

A Stage Girl who has loved stage plays since she was a child, and was led into the world of stage plays after watching "Starlight" with [url=/c133937]Karen[/url]. After performing the "fated stage play" with Karen, she has currently returned to studying at London’s Royal Institute of Dramatic Arts. She is striving towards becoming a stage actress while dreaming of the day she reunites with Karen on the stage.

[From [url=https://revuestarlight.bushiroadgames.com/en/character/hikari/]official website[/url]]
